title: Forever No. 1: Shelley Fabares, ‘Johnny Angel’
summary: When she dethroned Connie Francis, it marked the first time female singers had back-to-back No. 1s on the Hot 100.
body: Forever No. 1 is a Billboard series that pays special tribute to the recently deceased artists who achieved the highest honor our charts have to offer — a Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 single — by taking an extended look back at the chart-topping songs that made them part of this exclusive club. Here, we honor the late TV star Shelley Fabares, whose “Johnny Angel” reached No. 1 in April 1962. “Johnny Angel” is so innocent, so chaste, that it immediately conjures a simpler time. Astronomers put galaxies into three main categories: spirals like our own Milky Way with arms emanating from their cores, ellipticals that are older and likely the results of mergers, and irregulars that can encompass a wide range of galactic phenomena.
